success_boundaries.computational_screening: Does not imply experimental activity or safety
success_boundaries.experimental_source_support: Does not automatically transfer to another construct/context
success_boundaries.benchmark: Does not imply specificity, delivery or immune safety

missing_values: Preserve null/NOT_RUN and reasons; never replace with zero or a safe score

source_model_endpoints.Ridge: source annotation retained, not recomputed by this CLI
source_model_endpoints.Bench priority: native operational utility; known POTS direction limitation retained

technical_validation_contract.presentation: Lead with achieved technical gate status and predicted/calculated properties; retain candidate flags and one explicit scope statement. Never alter historical gates or receipts.
technical_validation_contract.scope_note: Technical validation covers declared computational checks; biological efficacy, safety and delivery are separate evaluation stages.

source_preservation: Immutable originals; new versioned directories; input/output hashes; no circular manifest/receipt hashes
